title: NOMENCLATURE ?????
path: RS2-1: The inanimate, physics, chemistry, astronomy

posts.content:
I was looking at unicode options for symbols, since there are thousands of them now. The problem is that most fonts do not support them all. Here is a list of the ones I was working with (character, unicode number, concept):

∠s 2220 single rotation, electric angle
∢s 2222 double rotation, solid/magnetic angle
t 23f0 clock time
⭙s 2b59 equivalent space
∿s 223f birotation (Re, Im axis)
ℊ ℜ 210a, 211c real
ℑ 2111 imaginary
ℂ 2102 complex
ℝ 211d real numbers
ℕ 2115 natural (1+)
ℤ 2124 integers
ℚ 211a rational
ℋ 210b quaternion
ℎ 210e planck constant
ℏ 201f reduced planck
℃ 2103 Centigrade
℉ 2109 Fahrenheit
Ω 2126 Resistance, ohms
℧ 2127 Conductance, siemens

I notice that the forum font does not show the Circle-X for "equivalent space" (displays a box with numbers in it on Firefox). I would prefer to use unicode characters over images.

Let me know which ones do not show up, and I'll look for alternatives.
